💡 The novelty lies in a spatially coordinated dual-interlayer design that sequentially suppresses Na dendrite initiation (3D Sn/C framework at Na|NBH) and propagation (NPSC sulfide interlayer within NBH). This raises critical current density from 0.5 to 3.3 mA cm⁻², enables 7000 h cycling, and supports high-loading full cells, establishing sequential dendrite control as a design principle for high-current hydroborate solid-state Na batteries.

item.description:

Advanced Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in a chemically integrated MnO₂/TiO₂ heterointerface with Ti─O─Mn bonding and residual carbon, inducing interfacial electronic reconstruction (reduced Ti states, charge redistribution, bond polarization). This activates Ti sites for enhanced polysulfide regulation, accelerating sulfur redox. Significance: enables stable cycling at 9.2 mg cm⁻² sulfur loading and 1569 mAh g⁻¹ capacity with only 0.054% decay per cycle over 1000 cycles, demonstrating oxide heterointerfaces as effective catalysts.

Advanced Materials | 💭 Perspective
💡 The novelty lies in shifting from a static, material-centric view to a dynamic interface-centric framework, arguing that cycling-induced interphase evolution (polysulfides, mixed-conducting interphases) preconditions sulfide ASSB thermal runaway. This explains inconsistent SO2 profiles and trigger temperatures, and reframes safety design toward dynamic interfacial control for truly robust solid-state batteries.
🏷 sulfide solid-state battery · thermal runaway · interfacial reconstruction · battery safety · interphase evolution

این مقاله با جداکننده SCOF-CMC/CS و میدان آنیونی پایدار، انتقال انتخابی Zn2+ و رسوب متراکم (002) روی آند روی را در باتری آبی یون روی ممکن ساخت.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in an anion-field interface (AFI) separator strategy using a biodegradable sulfonated COF in a CMC/chitosan dual-network, creating persistent negative electrostatic sites that suppress anions and enable selective Zn2+ transport. This guides dense (002)-textured Zn deposition, achieving over 2400 h cycling at 10 mA cm−2 and stable full cells, offering a sustainable route to durable aqueous zinc-ion batteries.

item.title: Constructing Room‐Temperature Core–Shell Hydride Ion Conductors via In Situ Formation of Ternary Hydrides
item.description:
این مقاله با ساخت پوسته هیدرید سه‌تایی Ce0.50Sr0.50H2.05 رسانای یون هیدرید هسته-پوسته در دمای اتاق با رسانایی 2.8×10−4 S cm−1 و عدد انتقال یونی بالای 0.99 ارائه می‌دهد.
Advanced Functional Materials | 🔬 Research Article
💡 The novelty lies in mechanochemically constructing a ternary-hydride shell (Ce0.50Sr0.50H2.05) that blocks electronic transport while enabling H− migration, yielding a core–shell conductor with high ionic conductivity (2.8×10−4 S cm−1) and transference number >0.99 at room temperature. Significance: cation substitution concurrently engineers electronic structure and hydrogen-vacancy topology, offering a general route to hydride conductors with negligible electronic leakage and fast ionic transport.

InfoMat | 🔬 Research Article | 🔓 Open Access
💡 The novelty lies in proposing a standardized, step-by-step protocol for Gaussian process-based DRT deconvolution of EIS data, avoiding manual parameter tuning required by regularized regression.
